purpose: Turn storage judgment into scripted evidence-resolution scenes so local agents implement product behavior instead of inventing it, while preserving the immersive Memory Atlas / Decision Chamber world.

authority.workflow: this contract owns judgment-scene routing and scene scripts
authority.presentation_lineage: PR #29 Decision Chamber lineage must be refreshed and reconciled before visualization mutation

local_prompt_owners: P94 Regression Test & Live Behavior Guard
P106 UX Product Designer & Interaction Architect
P110 UX Integrity & Cross-Viewport Acceptance Guard

adopted: task completion and real usage scene outrank expression for Operate surfaces
motion conveys state rather than decoration
interactive components require complete state coverage
distinctive visual identity is grounded in the product subject rather than template defaults

design_provenance.rule: Upstream references inform craft; FileSteward contracts and local Prompt Kit owners remain authority.

machine_owned: installed-application registration integrity and semantic uninstall/repair reachability
cross-domain multi-owner resolution and repo active/stable/legacy-candidate classification
operator_owned: whether an otherwise-safe application is wanted
whether a reproducible repository clone should remain local
archive/keep preference where safety is already known
local_agent_forbidden: inventing a new scene or interaction grammar to bridge missing judgment
asking the operator to decide a technical safety fact that adapters can determine
promoting ambiguity to reclaim because a user appears impatient
flattening a scripted scene into a generic dashboard or modal
changing accepted visual identity or interaction language during bounded implementation
judgment_boundary.unresolved_rule: Exhaust deterministic read-only evidence adapters before HUMAN_REVIEW. If a material fact remains unresolved, surface the exact missing fact, probes attempted, why it matters, and only safe operator choices.

preserved_tutorial.extension_rule: Attribution, consequence, recoverability, and value scenes are deterministic RESOLVE subscenes; do not replace the existing tutorial with a second tour.

scenes.purpose: Show capacity state and the next evidence-bearing cleanup opportunities without manufacturing deletion pressure.
automatic_work: rank candidates by impact subject to safety evidence
restore active filters/search where still applicable

render_script.headline: Storage health
forbidden_copy: generic Explore as a fallback action
pressure language when target capacity is already healthy

scenes.purpose: Make one storage target legible before asking for any judgment.
success_evidence: exact first unresolved gate is visible
no illegal action is rendered as operable

scenes.purpose: Route to the exact technical fact that blocks a safe decision.
automatic_work: start safe read-only resolver automatically when available

render_script.headline: Resolve what matters next
must_show: safe probe being run or exact blocker
render_script.primary_action_semantics: RUN/CONTINUE SAFE CHECK only when automation cannot start itself

success_evidence: operator is not asked to guess a technical fact

scenes.purpose: Determine what owns or depends on the selected storage.
automatic_work: correlate candidate tree against Windows uninstall/install/modify/repair/update paths before any cache/reclaim classification
detect broken installed state when registration survives but referenced serviceability executable is missing
build cross-domain ownership graph so application, repository, worktree, toolchain, service/task, package, generated-output, and user-data edges can coexist
when Entire CLI/Graph is available, use it to enrich current repository relationship/activity evidence without treating absence as deletion evidence

render_script.headline: Who owns these bytes?
render_script.operator_choice_policy: none unless all safe adapters are exhausted

success_evidence: normalized ownership evidence exists or exact unresolved fact is recorded

scenes.purpose: Determine what breaks or changes if the storage is acted on.
automatic_work: classify registered-app tree intersection or missing registered uninstaller/update executable as protected application/serviceability consequence
apply most-protective-edge-wins when storage has multiple owners/dependents
success_evidence: consequence class maps deterministically to a disposition floor

scenes.purpose: Prove whether bytes can be recreated or safely reacquired before offering reclaim.
automatic_work: prove deterministic application cache regeneration when claimed
prove repository remote/reproducibility and unique-work state
record unavailable network/provider as uncertainty rather than safety
never treat reinstall availability alone as permission for raw deletion of an installed application's live tree; semantic repair/uninstall remains the action boundary
success_evidence: reclaim eligibility never derives from age/size/path alone

scenes.purpose: Ask only the human judgment that remains after technical safety is resolved.
entry_when: safe adapters exhausted with exact unresolved fact
automatic_work: derive legal semantic actions from target kind + disposition
persist prior operator choice if context fingerprint still matches

render_script.headline: What do you want to keep?
must_show: plain-language owner/dependency badges such as Required by app, Part of active repo, Stable repo, Legacy repo candidate, Shared dependency, or Unknown ownership
forbidden_action_families: raw delete of app-owned runtime/serviceability files

success_evidence: operator choice concerns value/preference, not guessed technical safety

scenes.purpose: Bind one explicit operator authorization to exact target, semantic action, evidence revision, and projected consequence.
success_evidence: authorization artifact binds exact target/action/evidence revision

scenes.purpose: Execute the already-authorized semantic action through its repository-owned mechanism.

render_script.headline: Applying your decision
must_show: bytes not yet claimed until measured
render_script.motion_rule: motion may communicate progress/state only; no decorative choreography

scenes.purpose: Prove user value and return the operator to a coherent next scene.

render_script.headline: Verified
must_show: what changed or did not change
render_script.primary_action_semantics: CONTINUE TO NEXT RELEVANT DECISION or HOME

scenes.purpose: Turn a broken-app or other regression into a bounded recovery and retained prevention loop.
entry_when: operator reports regression linked to prior action

render_script.headline: Something changed unexpectedly
render_script.primary_action_semantics: RUN SAFE RECOVERY/DIAGNOSTIC when automatic continuation is impossible

success_evidence: regression family is added to retained ledger when systemic

automatic_transition_policy.allowed: Read-only technical RESOLVE scenes may auto-advance when their result is deterministic and remains inspectable in the action/evidence trace.
forbidden: skipping a scene whose unresolved fact can change safety
hiding a failed probe by advancing as if evidence existed

projection_requirements: every scene exposes purpose, primary impact, current evidence, one continuation, and legal actions
every visible action label names the immediate user-visible effect
classification and decisions persist into filterable views/queues
search/filter/selection state is orthogonal and preserved unless the user changes it or the selected target ceases to exist
renderers consume scene/action projections and do not invent semantics
missing script mapping fails closed as BLOCKED_JUDGMENT_GAP
